notes.title: 1.4.4.0 Small update to fix FPS issue
notes.content:
There was an issue with the framerate after a recent windows update that caused the game to stutter in an annoying way, leading to max framerate of around 20-30fps. I've updated the project to Gamemaker Studio 2 (from 1.4) and hopefully fixed this issue. Let me know if you find any problems with this update, thanks!

<3 Fermenter

notes.title: 1.3.3.7 Change Log
notes.content:
[h1]1.3.3.7 Change Log[/h1]

-----

[b]// NEW[/b]
◉ 1 New Mode, [b]ENDLESS CURSED[/b]! Fight off enemies AND deal with 5 game-changing curses that will break your brain.
◉ The 3 Gold, Silver, and Bronze boost trails are now awarded to any player who reaches the podium (1st, 2nd, or 3rd place) on any leaderboard. Have fun climbing the ranks!
◉ 2 New Ships: HARDCORE & CURSED.
◉ 1 New Achievements for 1 minute+ in CURSED.
◉ Now see your current ranking on the "Game Over" or "Zone Won" screens.

[b]// CHANGES/FIXES[/b]
• Minor Optimization and UX/UI fixes.

[b]// FAKE[/b]
• Use the "Konami Code" to unlock VR support.

-----

More to come! Working on even more funky new game modes for a future update. If you have more ideas or suggestions, send em to the SUGGESTION PIT here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/548230/discussions/0/224446432327400615/

Lastly, if you enjoy the game, please share with your friends. 'Tis the season, right?

Cheers,
Andrew

[b]BOSS 2 ZONE[/b]

[b]BOSS 3 ZONE[/b]

1. Esty was here, 2. snifidy, 3. Diegovz01

-----

Cheers cheers cheers! 

That's 4 different Gold winners, 4 Silver, and 4 Bronze. RAD! Be sure to show these fancy new trails off in the community with screenshots.

After updating, your trail awards should be automatically granted (based on your Steam ID) when you start the game. If that doesn't happen, let me know and I'll help you out.

[b]Lastly, I've got a question for the winners:[/b] I'd like to let more people have these fancy new trails in the future. In a future update, I [i]could[/i] make it so that when a player gets a top 3 spot on the leaderboards, it would automatically award a winner trail to them. Also, once you've recieved a winner trail, it's yours, and you won't lose it even if you fall off the leaderboard. I think that'd be a pretty neat way to allow top players to get these pretty things. What do you think?? Do we let new players have a shot at getting these trails, or should only you you 12 winners have the privelege?

- Andrew

notes.title: 1.2.5 Change Log
notes.content:
[h1]1.2.5 Change Log[/h1]

-----

[b]// NEW[/b]
◉ 3 New Trails to award 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners in Launch Week Competition (automatically awarded to winners) (Winners anounced here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/548230/announcements/detail/582483144493408665)
◉ 1 New Trail for early supporters (automatically awarded to existing players)
◉ 2 New Ships: TWURKY & CROWN.
◉ 2 New SECRET Achievements ;)
◉ Sidebar Art choices in Options
◉ Controller Vibration Toggle in Options

[b]// CHANGES/FIXES[/b]
• Endless rebalancing for late game. (Cap enemy-on-screen amount, cap spawn rate, rebalance spawn multiplier amount, don’t allow Freezer enemy until later in game.)
• Enemy bullets now appear above enemies. Easier to see!
• Freezer enemy slightly nerfed (again!)
• Fix for windowed mode not showing HP and ammo UI

[b]// FAKE[/b]
• First-Person Camera mode.

-----

More to come! Working on some funky new game modes for a future update. If you have more ideas or suggestions, send em to the SUGGESTION PIT here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/548230/discussions/0/224446432327400615/

Cheers,
Andrew

◉ 1 New Trail for early supporters (automatically awarded to existing players)
